tools.name: create_chat
tools.description: Create a chat with its first turn. intelligence picks a mode preset and provider biases vendor selection within it. Turns run asynchronously; set wait_for_response to block until the answer is ready, otherwise poll get_message with the returned message_id.

chat.description: prompt is required. intelligence is one of "auto", "fast", "expert", "research" and empty defaults to "auto". provider is one of "automatic", "anthropic", "openai", "google". An empty scope sees the whole project

tools.name: create_label

tools.name: create_memory

tools.name: create_project

tools.name: create_project_invitation

A project holds one invitation per role: when one already exists the email is added to it, and re-inviting an email already on it succeeds unchanged.

invitation.description: email is required. role is one of "collaborator", "reader", "owner"

tools.name: create_skill

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Get a single session by ID: its lifecycle state, live summary, and turn_count. Use it for what a session decided and what came out of it; for what was actually said (quotes, who said what, when), use get_session_transcript. state distinguishes a finished session (session.ended) from one still scheduled or running. The live summary is the canonical record of what the session decided: its items with kind todo are the follow-ups. The turns field is deprecated and will be removed; read the transcript with get_session_transcript.

tools.name: get_session_transcript
tools.description: Read one page of a session's transcript, oldest turn first: the words actually spoken, each turn with its index, speaker label, text, and m:ss timecode when the recording has one. Use it for quotes, who said what, or when something came up; use get_session for the outcome (live summary, todos). With no cursor it starts at the beginning of the meeting; before_id set to the session's turn_count (from get_session) returns the most recent turns. While has_more is true, pass last_id as after_id to read forward, or first_id as before_id to read backward. Pages hold up to 100 turns. Indices are stable once the session has ended (state session.ended); while it is still recording, turns merged from another device can shift them.

limit.description: turns per page, 1 to 100; defaults to 25

after_id.description: the previous page's last_id; returns the turns after that index

before_id.description: a turn index, or the session's turn_count for the most recent turns; returns the turns just before it, still oldest first

tools.name: get_share_link
tools.description: Get a chat's share-link status. url and created_at are empty when the chat isn't shared.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get a single skill by ID, including its content and enabled state for the caller.

limit.description: maximum number of actions to return; the server clamps to its own bounds

after_id.description: page forward from this action ID

before_id.description: page backward from this action ID

Each item carries the session's lifecycle state, so finished sessions (state session.ended) can be picked out without fetching each one. Use after_id / before_id with the returned first_id / last_id to page.

limit.description: maximum number of sessions to return; the server clamps to its own bounds

after_id.description: page forward from this session ID

before_id.description: page backward from this session ID

limit.description: maximum number of skills to return; the server clamps to its own bounds

after_id.description: page forward from this skill ID

before_id.description: page backward from this skill ID

tools.name: regenerate_share_link
tools.description: Revoke a chat's current share link, if any, and mint a new URL. The old URL stops working immediately.

tools.name: remove_chat_member
tools.description: Remove one user from a restricted chat's audience by user_id. The chat must already be restricted; other visibility levels respond 409.

user_id.description: the user to remove; use the user_id returned by list_chat_members

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search the project's documents and return the passages that answer a question. Use this whenever the user asks about their own files, uploads, or project content, rather than guessing from memory. The search is semantic, so phrase the query as a natural question; keywords work poorly. Searches the whole project unless you pass asset_ids, label_ids, view_ids, or concept_ids. Each result carries an asset and its matching passages, best first, with a relevance_score from 0 to 1 where higher is a stronger match. Quote the passages rather than paraphrasing them, and cite the asset title. Requires a paid plan.

query.description: the question to answer, in natural language; this is a semantic search, so write a question rather than keywords

max_results.description: maximum passages to return, 1 to 50; defaults to 10

asset_ids.description: restrict the search to these assets; omit every list to search the whole project

label_ids.description: restrict the search to assets carrying these labels

view_ids.description: restrict the search to the assets in these views

concept_ids.description: restrict the search to the assets behind these concepts

indexed_only.description: skip the slower pass that reads documents still being ingested; set this when speed matters more than covering a just-uploaded file

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Append a turn to an existing chat. The tuning fields match create_chat. Turns run asynchronously; set wait_for_response to block until the answer is ready, otherwise poll get_message with the returned message_id.

chat_id.description: the chat to append a turn to

message.description: prompt is required. The tuning fields match create_chat

wait_for_response.description: block until the turn finishes and the response is ready before returning

timeout_seconds.description: seconds to wait when wait_for_response is set; defaults to 360

tools.name: set_chat_visibility
tools.description: Set a chat's access level: "project" lets every project member read it, "restricted" limits reads to the owner plus the audience managed via the chat member tools, "private" is owner-only. Setting restricted keeps any audience the chat already had; switching to project or private clears it.

tools.name: update_action
tools.description: Replace an action's configuration. The body is a full replacement: any schedule, trigger, scope, or email section omitted from action is cleared.

action.description: the full replacement action body; omitted schedule, trigger, scope, or email sections are cleared

tools.name: update_asset
tools.description: Patch an asset's name and/or description. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

name.description: new display name; omit to leave unchanged

description.description: new description; omit to leave unchanged

tools.name: update_chat
tools.description: Rename a chat. title is the only mutable field and must not be empty.

chat.description: title is the only mutable field and must not be empty

tools.name: update_label
tools.description: Patch a label's display metadata. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Color, when set, must be a 6-digit hex code like #6b7280.

label.description: the patch; omitted fields are left unchanged. color, when set, must be a 6-digit hex code like #6b7280

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Update a memory. content is replaced; category and importance are optional patches. category is one of: identity, preference, fact, context, instruction.

memory.description: content is replaced; category and importance are optional patches. category is one of: identity, preference, fact, context, instruction

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Replace a project's name and description — the only two mutable fields. The body is a full set, not a patch: an empty description clears it.

project.description: the full set of the two mutable fields, not a patch; an empty description clears it

tools.name: update_session
tools.description: Patch a session's name and/or description. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

session.description: name and/or description patch; omitted fields are left unchanged

tools.name: update_skill
tools.description: Patch a skill. Omitted fields are left unchanged. category, when set, must be "skill" or "persona". System skills are read-only.

skill.description: the patch; omitted fields are left unchanged. category, when set, must be "skill" or "persona"

wait_for_ready.description: block until the asset finishes ingesting before returning

timeout_seconds.description: seconds to wait when wait_for_ready is set; defaults to 120

operations.description: Search the project's documents and return the passages that answer a question. Use this whenever the user asks about their own files, uploads, or project content, rather than guessing from memory. The search is semantic, so phrase the query as a natural question; keywords work poorly. Searches the whole project unless you pass asset_ids, label_ids, view_ids, or concept_ids. Each result carries an asset and its matching passages, best first, with a relevance_score from 0 to 1 where higher is a stronger match. Quote the passages rather than paraphrasing them, and cite the asset title. Requires a paid plan.
